decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already records the necessary cap-height relationship: E and L match the second V's left arm while only its right arm rises above them.
The source changes the scale of E and L, not the second V's proportional construction or inherited right-arm geometry.
Scaling E and L to a new cap height does not change the already selected shared baseline alignment.
The Hero V and its left arm are used only as established references; the source does not change the Hero V's geometry or role.
The source message's selection of Variation B is already represented by a same-message MODIFY, while the E/L height change adds no further kerning update.
The request to verify the accent as an exact copy/paste reaffirms the existing derivation rule and does not modify it.
The E/L scale refinement does not alter the preservation policy or the listed locked Hero V, second V, and accent assets.
The source does not change the required shared peak alignment between the Hero V and É accent.
The letterform height adjustment has no effect on the deferred champagne material treatment.
The source selects a presented variation and requests a letterform refinement but does not change the required comparison-proof format.
Changing E and L height does not affect the all-caps wordmark treatment.
The source contains no decision about review-image delivery formats or file accessibility.
